name: Victoria Hospital Maternity Block
scope: The surviving 1921 Old Victoria Hospital Maternity Block, now known as Victoria Flats, at 17 Barker Road on The Peak. The present exterior includes the hill-facing rear, three stories, open arcaded base, red brick pilasters, pale panels and the centered Venetian-window pediment.
era: Surviving 1921 maternity block as converted to Victoria Flats

originalReview.notes: Shows the standing maternity block from the approach, with grey voussoir archways, reddish brick pilasters, white horizontal panels, dark window grids and the Venetian-window pediment above.

review.method: Exact Qualla original and signed native own-work public-domain release.
review.notes: Lookchard’s Qualla exterior byte-matches the original photographer’s signed own-work public-domain upload. The unrelated dim sum picture was excluded.
